<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Deal Flow</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues. However, each of you agreed that a standard cutoff time was acceptable for UK corporate advisory, M&A, and litigation support engagements.

The best option will be to agree to cutoff at 4pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many engagements were logged after 4pm London time. We had three UK Corporate Advisory deals, and two EU Corporate deals). After 4pm, the Compliance systems would automatically roll new Corporate Advisory deals to the next day. However, for those deals that do not bridge after 4pm, the various practice groups would need to remember that these deals are the following day's business. I am not sure how the procedures in the Risk & Compliance department would need to be modified for the fee earner's caseload reports, as the official books would not include these late deals. Can the Risk & Compliance department run supplemental reports to ensure that the teams have accurate positions each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a cutoff of 4pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the Daily Position Report?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
